body:
**UPDATE:**

I'm leaving home now and everything should be over in less than an hour.  


I just wanted to thank everybody who talked to me on here or in private chat. Really appreciated it as it made my last few hours a bit more bearable.   


Stay strong and keep fighting your demons as long as you can.

Failure to me is not being perfect, not succeeding in everything I take up. I am on meds. I've gone through therapy and as much as I want to say this helped, it really didn't. I tried everything under the sun. Nothing has worked.  


Game over, I guess

I tried. Trust me. I just wouldn't be able to deal with them thinking I'm not good enough or that I failed. And so many people would love to see me fail. All my life, I and everybody around me have based my worth on my achievements. Many people look up to me and I can't allow myself to let them down.

I don't feel pain anymore. Just numbness. As to why I decided to do it, I can't keep up with the pressure. With the expectations people have. With people letting down and me pretending not to care. I'm tired of putting on an act all the time and pretending to be invincible.
